The very first heading in this document is raw HTML (`

This is intended as a clean, low-risk markdown baseline (paired with fixture 12, which adds an ASCII-art terminal-banner false-positive-table risk on top of a similar README structure) -- not one of the two named weak-spot categories, so needs_human_review is false, but the image-only-H1 case is worth a spot-check regardless.
